turns.prompt_text: how do I blow a ring with a vape
turns.response_html:
Blowing vape rings (or "O’s") is the classic "Day 1" trick of the vaping world. It’s less about how hard you blow and more about how you control the air and the shape of your mouth.

Here is the breakdown of how to get it right:

1. The Prep

You need "thick" vapor to make the ring visible and stable.

  • The Hit: Take a long pull, but don’t inhale it all the way into your lungs. Keep most of it in your throat and mouth.
  • The Calm: Make sure you aren't in a drafty room. Even a ceiling fan can tear a ring apart before it fully forms.

2. The Shape (The "O")

This is where most people struggle.

  • Form your mouth into an "O" shape.
  • Tuck your lips: Instead of puckering like you're going for a kiss, tuck your lips slightly over your teeth.
  • Size matters: Your mouth should be about the size of a quarter or a small plum. If it's too wide, the vapor just clouds out; too small, and the ring won't have enough surface area to stay together.

3. The "Cough" (The Push)

You aren't actually blowing air with your lungs. You want a tiny, controlled burst of air from your throat.

  • The Technique: Imagine you are making a very light, silent "uh-uh-uh" sound or a tiny "hiccup" in reverse.
  • The Jaw: Some people find it easier to keep their throat still and instead give a tiny, quick "flick" of their jaw upward to push a small amount of air out.
  • The Tongue: Keep your tongue flat at the bottom of your mouth and pulled back toward your throat so it doesn't get in the way of the vapor exit.

Troubleshooting

  • If it’s just a cloud: Your mouth shape isn't tight enough, or you’re blowing too hard.
  • If the ring is thin: You might be inhaling too much. Try keeping the vapor denser in your mouth.
  • If the ring dies immediately: You’re likely in a room with too much airflow.
